subject: Mutual Action Plan: Redwood MAP & ACME POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood MAP / Acme POC

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can turn this into a short mutual action plan: 

Pain points you shared:
- Current inference costs on burst loads are spiking and causing budget churn across teams.
- Latency spikes for the customer-facing search assistant during peak windows (approx 800–1200ms p95).
- Security/compliance constraints: logs must be retained for 12 months and KMS integration required for key management.

Goals we discussed:
- Reduce per-token unit cost by ~30% for typical search workload.
- Steady p95 latency under 400ms for end-user queries.
- Validate private deployment options for regulated workflows by end of Q1.

Proposed next steps (high level):
1) Redwood to deliver a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and dates — deliverable: MAP draft by Wed 12/2.
2) Technical POC: 2-week test on a subset of queries (sample workload) — target start 12/6.
3) Security checklist & KMS onboarding — Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence and KMS integration doc by 12/9.
4) Commercial: rough order of magnitude pricing and pilot contract — Redwood sales will provide by 12/9.

Stakeholders you indicated:
- Samantha Green — Data Platform (primary sponsor)
- Tom Lee — Product (POC owner)
- Procurement (procurement@acme.com) — procurement/legal
If those dates/owners look right I’ll send the MAP as a single doc and add owners/assignees.
Thanks again — feeling good about the fit and look forward to moving fast.
Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: (will follow)

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood MAP / Acme POC

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches our internal notes. A few clarifications / confirmations from our side: 

- Timeline: the dates you suggested look good. The team is available for a 2-week POC starting 12/6. Procurement needs final numbers before 12/16 to get approval for a pilot spend.
- Tech scope: for the POC we want Redwood to run on a dedicated instance (or equivalent isolation) and show cost/latency delta vs our current hosted endpoint.
- Security: SOC2 report and KMS flow will be reviewed by our security team (cc’d procurement for compliance intake). They may request a short questionnaire — I’ll send that by end of day Tuesday.

Stakeholder note: please add our Security lead (Asha Verma) to the MAP when you send the doc — I’m looped in but Asha will sign off on retention/KMS specifics.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of Data Platform | Acme Corp
samantha.green@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) — Redwood MAP & Acme POC

Samantha / Tom —

Per our call and your note, attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf). High-level milestones:

1) MAP sign-off — Owner: Samantha Green / Asha Verma (Security) — Due: 2026-12-02
2) POC kickoff — Owner: Tom Lee / Redwood Eng (Dev Patel) — Start: 2026-12-06; Duration: 2 weeks
3) Security evidence & KMS onboarding — Owner: Asha Verma / Rishi Malhotra — Due: 2026-12-09
4) Pilot commercial proposal — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2026-12-09
5) Procurement approval for pilot — Owner: Procurement (procurement@acme.com) — Target approval by: 2026-12-16

Notes / assumptions:
- POC success criteria: demonstrate >=25% cost reduction at 95% confidence on sample workload and p95 latency <= 400ms under the test profile.
- Redwood will provide a pre-configured sample workload and onboarding runbook ahead of the kickoff.
- Any additional integration work outside the two-week window will be scoped separately.

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (security evidence stub)

Please review and suggest any edits to owners/dates. If everything looks good I’ll convert to a shared Google Sheet and add task assignees.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

Marissa —

Thanks, received the MAP and the timeline looks good to me. I’ve added Asha to the thread and procurement is looped in. We’ll review the MAP today and get you any edits by EOD. Procurement flagged one ask: can you include a short pilot SOW paragraph (one-paragraph scope + estimated cost range) in the next MAP iteration so they can fast-track internal approval?

If you can add that, we should be able to approve the pilot spend by 12/16. Looking forward to the kickoff on 12/6.

Tom
